Third-party notices for opensheetmusicdisplay.min.js
====================================================

opensheetmusicdisplay.min.js is the unmodified OpenSheetMusicDisplay 2.2.0 browser build
(BSD-3-Clause, see LICENSE and AUTHORS in this folder). The build bundles the libraries
below; their license texts follow. The bundle's header comment refers to a
opensheetmusicdisplay.min.js.LICENSE.txt file that the npm package does not ship; this
file takes its place.
